payload.body: vc to dc: one more for the same worktree, after 0095. It is 0096 (XS), filed from molt-vc's WSL2 proof run. The ssh liberator comments a new key with git config --global user.email, which reads no include, so an identity that only an included file gives never reaches the key: the proof's first run made a key commented dev@devvm. Make that lookup git config --global --includes user.email, with the fallback as it is. Add a bats test whose identity only an include gives, red at its base and green at the fix under both bashes, on a light ask. Claim ISSUE:0096, and make it one commit, with its CHANGELOG line under Changed in [1.4.5]. Then send READY for all four.
